AI training data & practice environments

11 companies
  • Abundant →

    Builds simulated tasks and training data for AI programs that carry out work.

  • BenchFlow →

    Builds practice tasks and tests for AI programs that carry out work. It also provides tools to run those tests.

  • Bespoke Labs →

    Builds realistic practice tasks for AI programs that carry out work. Its tools help teams train and test those programs.

  • Datacurve →

    Recruits experienced developers to create coding data and test AI coding tools.

  • Labelbox →

    Builds practice tasks and expert feedback for AI training. Its business software runs AI programs that carry out tasks.

  • Ooak Data →

    Turns real business work into AI practice tasks while removing identifying details from the data.

  • Polymath →

    Builds simulated software tasks that train AI to complete extended engineering work.

  • Proximal →

    Turns records of human and AI work into training data. Its tests measure AI performance on demanding technical tasks.

Coverage and sources

The guide is a selected study of the market. It does not list every company. Firms not yet listed in this directory include Uber AI Solutions, TELUS Digital, CloudFactory, SuperAnnotate, Encord, Defined.ai, LXT and Welocalize.

The 14 current additions retain separate dated Wikipedia attribution and official-source offering checks. They do not change the 39-company historical dataset or published research coverage.

Each figure keeps its reporting date, business scope and source. Historical profiles list any paid work recorded. Two of the 53 are nonprofit research groups.
